title: The Whispering Waves
logline: A retired lighthouse keeper uncovers the secrets of the past through an old radio that picks up mysterious messages from vanished ships.

characters.name: Jack Harris
characters.one_line_description: A solitary, aged man with a deep sense of nostalgia and longing for the past.

scenes.title: Discovery
scenes.summary: Jack finds an old radio while cleaning the lighthouse.

scenes.title: First Message
scenes.summary: Jack turns on the radio and hears a faint distress call from a ship that vanished decades ago.

scenes.title: Research
scenes.summary: Jack researches the history of the ship and its disappearance.

scenes.title: Nighttime Transmission
scenes.summary: Jack listens to more messages from the radio, feeling an eerie connection to the past.

scenes.title: Reflection
scenes.summary: Jack reflects on his life and the significance of the messages, wondering if they're a metaphor for his own lost connections.

scenes.title: The Final Message
scenes.summary: Jack hears a final, poignant message that leaves him with more questions than answers.

scenes.title: The Waves Whisper On
scenes.summary: Jack stands at the lighthouse window, listening to the waves, as the radio falls silent in the background.

source_idea: A retired lighthouse keeper finds an old radio that picks up messages from ships that vanished decades ago
